changelog: DVR: Fire TV file manager now opens reliably — removed EXTRA_INITIAL_URI that caused Amazon's picker to crash or show blank on all Firestick models
Account Manager: signed-in server now always appears in the Account tab immediately after login (auto-registers from stored credentials)

Account Manager: Add/Edit Account dialog redesigned as a full-screen branded popup matching the login screen — Account Name, Server URL, Username, Password, usage type (Live TV / DVR Only / All Features)
Account Manager: full D-pad navigation in the Add/Edit dialog; Cancel and Save buttons reachable with directional keys on Firestick remote
DVR Choose Drive: added safe fallback intent (no initial URI) when volume-specific picker fails on older Fire OS versions
